The bowl carries a few folded seed packets. Her shoulders and elbows follow the small downward movement, and both forearms have room between her body and the table edge. She glances down at the bowl with an unguarded, absorbed expression. Seed envelopes, a pencil, a chipped mug and another person's sleeve at the far edge suggest the room is shared, but her face, both hands, and the bowl remain distinct and readable. A bright side window flares across one patch of the table while the deeper room falls dim; the camcorder holds both in the same imperfect exposure. A short motion trace trails the descending bowl and sleeve, while facial detail, painted glaze, paper fibers, and the bowl-to-wood contact remain legible. Frame it at chest height with a slightly wide consumer-video perspective, subtle sensor grain and natural color unevenness, as one unposed moment.
